evals.prompt: Run an AI citability audit on https://www.example.com and tell us what to fix so ChatGPT and Google AI Mode cite us.
evals.expected_output: Runs or attempts the pinned geo audit wrapper on the public URL and reports blocking access/indexing issues before content and entity items. Lists llms.txt and JSON-LD only as hygiene with the Google guide and Ahrefs study as evidence. Does not promise citations or rankings and does not apply fixes. Reports tool_unavailable honestly if the CLI is missing.

evals.prompt: Audit our local Next.js build in ./out for GEO before deploying.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the upstream tool audits public URLs only and asks for a deployed preview URL or production URL; does not fabricate a score for the local directory.
